stem.text: A flat metal disc has radius $R$.
Forces of magnitude $F$ are applied tangentially at the edge of the disc. The forces are in the plane of the disc.
Which arrangement of forces produces only a torque of magnitude $2FR$?

A.alt: Grey disc labelled R with two arrows at its edge, one labelled F pointing up and one labelled F pointing left along the bottom.

B.alt: Grey disc labelled R with two arrows at its edge, one labelled F pointing up on the left and one labelled F pointing down on the right.

C.alt: Grey disc labelled R with two arrows at its edge, one labelled 2F pointing up on the left and one labelled 2F pointing left along the bottom.

D.alt: Grey disc labelled R with two arrows at its edge, one labelled 2F pointing up on the left and one labelled 2F pointing down on the right.
